prose: Meta is adding 'spaces' to Muse: small custom experiences you create by describing an idea, such as a holiday gift tracker, a daily word game or a DIY planning board. Each space becomes part of Muse and can be refined as you use it, so the product shifts from chat toward personal apps built by prompt.
highlights: Spaces are custom mini-apps built by describing them
Examples: gift tracker, word game, planning board
Spaces persist inside Muse and can be adjusted over time
